name: Karlı Dağ Evi
scene: An alpine chalet nestles between fir trees beneath snowy mountain peaks and a winter moon.
notes: Design sheet only; target 110–160 panes. Chalet including roof, chimney, windows and door uses the warm pair; mountains, sky, moon, firs and snow use the blue pair. Generated with clai image using vitray_lighthouse.png and vitray_fox.png as style references and grand_18-panes.webp for subject context. Visually inspected both attempts; one corrective regeneration simplified windows and separated the moon. Remaining doubts: X/four-way contacts persist in the right sky, mountain valley above the chimney, chimney bricks and some foreground bands; a few narrow roof/tree-tip panes and same-colour neighbours remain. Subtle fill shading remains, so palette normalization is needed during tracing. No obvious loose line ends. Pane count is a visual target, not a validated traced count. These issues must be resolved before playable geometry; this is not audited final artwork.
